subject.title: Backup: add encrypted snapshot backup flow

question: Should OpenClaw core accept this native encrypted folder-backed snapshot backup surface after the security fixes and proof are added, or should the snapshot/cloud-folder workflow be narrowed or deferred outside core?
rationale: The branch changes destructive restore behavior, backup target writes, secrets-adjacent config, and user data recovery semantics; automation can identify defects but cannot decide the long-term core backup security and product boundary.

options.title: Sponsor core snapshot backup after repair
options.body: Keep the PR open, require the security fixes, conflict resolution, and current-head real behavior proof, then do maintainer security/product review before merge.

options.title: Narrow to local archive lifecycle
options.body: Ask for a smaller PR that only advances export/verify/restore while postponing folder-backed encrypted snapshots and workspace mirroring.

options.title: Defer folder/off-machine workflows
options.body: Close or replace this branch and direct folder/cloud/off-machine backup workflows to ClawHub or a plugin unless a missing core API is identified.

recommendation.title: Sponsor core snapshot backup after repair
recommendation.body: Keep the PR open, require the security fixes, conflict resolution, and current-head real behavior proof, then do maintainer security/product review before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: This person merged the original local backup CLI and has adjacent backup infrastructure history, making them the best available routing owner for the core/security boundary decision.
